mapper.sql: A.AUTH_CODE AS packageId, A.AUTH_NAME_HAN AS name, LOWER(TRIM(A.AUTH_NAME_HAN)) AS nameKey, (A.USE_IND = 'Y') AS active, (A.SUPER_ADMIN_IND = 'Y') AS superAdmin, A.DATA_SCOPE_CODE AS scopeType
mapper.select: SELECT FROM AUTHMSTR A WHERE LOWER(TRIM(A.AUTH_NAME_HAN)) = #{nameKey} ORDER BY A.AUTH_CODE LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM AUTHMSTR A ORDER BY LOWER(TRIM(A.AUTH_NAME_HAN)), A.AUTH_CODE

SELECT D.AUTH_CODE AS packageId, D.PGM_ID AS programId, (D.ACCESS_IND = 'Y') AS accessAllowed, (D.READ_IND = 'Y') AS readAllowed, (D.WRITE_IND = 'Y') AS writeAllowed, (D.EXPORT_IND = 'Y') AS exportAllowed FROM AUTHDTL D WHERE D.AUTH_CODE = #{packageId} ORDER BY D.PGM_ID
SELECT O.AUTH_CODE AS packageId, O.ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, O.ORG_CODE AS districtCode FROM AUTHORG O WHERE O.AUTH_CODE = #{packageId} ORDER BY O.ORG_MSTR_CODE, O.ORG_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTHMSTR (AUTH_CODE, AUTH_NAME_HAN, DATA_SCOPE_CODE, SUPER_ADMIN_IND, USE_IND, SYS_RUSR_ID, SYS_RUSR_IP, SYS_RUSR_DTTM, SYS_MUSR_ID, SYS_MUSR_IP, SYS_MUSR_DTTM) VALUES (#{packageId}, #{name}, #{scopeType}, IF(#{superAdmin}, 'Y', 'N'), IF(#{active}, 'Y', 'N'), #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE AUTHMSTR SET AUTH_NAME_HAN = #{name}, DATA_SCOPE_CODE = #{scopeType}, USE_IND = IF(#{active}, 'Y', 'N'), SYS_MUSR_ID = #{sysUserId}, SYS_MUSR_IP = #{sysIp}, SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{sysAt} WHERE AUTH_CODE = #{packageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTHDTL (AUTH_CODE, PGM_ID, ACCESS_IND, READ_IND, WRITE_IND, EXPORT_IND, SYS_RUSR_ID, SYS_RUSR_IP, SYS_RUSR_DTTM, SYS_MUSR_ID, SYS_MUSR_IP, SYS_MUSR_DTTM) VALUES (#{packageId}, #{programId}, IF(#{accessAllowed}, 'Y', 'N'), IF(#{readAllowed}, 'Y', 'N'), IF(#{writeAllowed}, 'Y', 'N'), IF(#{exportAllowed}, 'Y', 'N'), #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt})

INSERT INTO AUTHORG (AUTH_CODE, ORG_MSTR_CODE, ORG_CODE, SYS_RUSR_ID, SYS_RUSR_IP, SYS_RUSR_DTTM, SYS_MUSR_ID, SYS_MUSR_IP, SYS_MUSR_DTTM) VALUES (#{packageId}, #{regionCode}, #{districtCode}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt})
